basis: A subaortic membrane causes structural obstruction of the left ventricular outflow tract.
Inherited hepatic bilirubin transport disorder; gastric mucosal morphology alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Motor neuron disease; denervation causes muscle weakness/atrophy in most reported patients and scoliosis in 2/3. Respiratory weakness does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Defined by fibrous dysplasia of bone and intramuscular myxomas, both within the musculoskeletal axis.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, reported in 4/4 patients.
IFIH1-related antiviral immunodeficiency; recurrent viral pneumonia is a separate infection rather than intrinsic pulmonary disease.
Copper metabolism disorder with hepatic injury; neurologic damage occurs in about half. Kayser-Fleischer rings do not impair ocular function.
Noncutaneous melanoma arising in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the axes; dysuria alone does not establish urinary tract damage.
Defined by autonomic paraganglial and adrenal chromaffin tumors. Renal carcinoma and GIST are separate tumor risks; hearing damage is not established as common.
Pain insensitivity with hyperplastic myelinopathy indicates peripheral nerve disease; no evidence establishes common additional organ damage.
Benign myofibroblastic tumor typically arising in dermal, subcutaneous or muscular soft tissue; its branching vessels do not imply vascular disease.
Umbrella explicitly includes peripheral nerve, neuromuscular junction and skeletal muscle disorders.
Benign epithelial tumor arising in the kidney.
Fallopian tube disease is confined to a reproductive organ outside the axes; infection is not shared across this umbrella.
Neurodevelopmental disease, skeletal anomalies and mosaic skin changes define the syndrome; heart failure and pulmonary arterial hypertension are annotated at 80-99%.
Bone is occupied by metastases in roughly 80-90% of metastatic prostate cancer, providing the dominant applicable site; the prostate itself has no axis.
Traction osteochondrosis of the tibial tuberosity growth region; local inflammation does not establish an immune-mediated disease.
Protozoal infection umbrella; cardiac injury in Chagas disease and CNS disease in African trypanosomiasis are not common across the whole group.
Bone dysplasia, skin atrophy and metabolic lipodystrophy define MAD; dental hypoplasia/crowding occur in 30-79%. Globe enlargement alone is not ocular damage.
Inherited glycosylation disorder; developmental disability, seizures and neurologic dysfunction occur in most subtypes. Hypercoagulability is subtype-specific.
Familial excessive androgen secretion from the adrenal endocrine gland.
Post-traumatic heterotopic bone formation in skeletal muscle or adjacent soft tissue; not an autoimmune myositis.
Distal amyotrophy 14/14 and skeletal deformities ~50%; intrinsic hypercholesterolemia 9/12. Oculomotor apraxia is neurologic; hypoalbuminemia alone is not hepatic injury.
Vitamin A excess causes common epithelial toxicity with desquamation and alopecia (~30%+); substantial hepatic, skeletal and neurologic injury varies by acute/chronic form.
Hypothalamic/endocrine dysfunction, dysautonomia and hypoventilation define ROHHAD; hearing loss annotated 80-99%. GI dysmotility and reduced lacrimation omitted by cap.
